boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named public destinations in the walkable Hoboken streets and waterfront immediately below Stevens’ Castle Point campus.

cards.title: Castle Point Skate Park
cards.subtitle: Sinatra Drive corridor, near 8th Street
cards.notes: Walk downhill to the city-listed skateboarding facility on Sinatra Drive near 8th Street; bring a board only if you intend to use the designated park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Hoboken lists Castle Point Skate Park on Sinatra Drive near 8th Street and identifies its use as skateboarding only.
cards.source_title: City of Hoboken Parks, Fields & Facilities
cards.access_notes: City-listed public facility; follow posted park rules.

cards.title: Elysian Park
cards.subtitle: Hudson Street corridor, between 10th and 11th Streets
cards.notes: Use the Hudson Street corridor to reach this named city park and its basketball courts; check the court before planning a pickup game.
cards.short_summary: A city park with documented basketball courts.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Hoboken lists Elysian Park on Hudson Street between 10th and 11th Streets and identifies basketball courts there.
cards.source_title: City of Hoboken Parks, Fields & Facilities
cards.access_notes: City-listed public park; court availability is not guaranteed.

cards.title: Maxwell Place Park
cards.subtitle: 11th Street corridor, at 1 11th Street
cards.notes: Head along the 11th Street corridor to the city-listed Maxwell Place Park, then use it as a waterfront stop while continuing north or south.
cards.short_summary: A named park on the 11th Street waterfront approach.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Hoboken lists Maxwell Place Park at 1 11th Street.
cards.access_notes: City-listed public park; follow posted rules.

cards.title: Shipyard Park
cards.subtitle: 14th Street corridor, at 1 14th Street
cards.notes: Continue north on the waterfront/14th Street corridor to the named Shipyard Park; use the public park areas and respect any resident-only sections.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Hoboken lists Shipyard Park at 1 14th Street.
cards.access_notes: The City notes that Shipyard Park’s dog run is private for residents only; use public areas only.

cards.title: Pier C Park
cards.subtitle: Sinatra Drive corridor, 340 Sinatra Drive
cards.notes: Follow the Sinatra Drive waterfront corridor to Pier C, where the city documents a promenade, fishing pier, play area, water-play area, and rookery.
cards.short_summary: A waterfront park with several documented features.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Hoboken lists Pier C Park at 340 Sinatra Drive with a fishing pier, play area, water-play area, rookery, and promenade.
cards.source_title: City of Hoboken Parks, Fields & Facilities
cards.access_notes: City-listed public park; individual amenities may have posted seasonal rules.

cards.title: Pier A Park
cards.subtitle: Sinatra Drive corridor, 100 Sinatra Drive
cards.notes: Continue south on the Sinatra Drive corridor to the named Pier A Park; use the great lawn, gazebo, or fishing area as conditions allow.
cards.short_summary: A city waterfront park with a lawn, gazebo, and fishing.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Hoboken lists Pier A Park at 100 Sinatra Drive and identifies fishing, a great lawn, and a gazebo.
cards.source_title: City of Hoboken: Pier A Park
cards.access_notes: City-listed public park; dogs are not permitted on the interior walkway.

cards.title: Sinatra Park
cards.subtitle: Sinatra Drive corridor, between 4th and 5th Streets
cards.notes: Stop on the Sinatra Drive corridor at the city-listed park to see the outdoor amphitheater, kayak launch, and multipurpose field from public areas.
cards.short_summary: A waterfront park with an amphitheater and kayak launch.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Hoboken lists Sinatra Park between 4th and 5th Streets on Sinatra Drive with a kayak launch, outdoor amphitheater, and soccer field.
cards.access_notes: City-listed public park; field and launch use may be subject to posted conditions.

cards.title: Stevens Park (Little League Field)
cards.subtitle: Hudson Street corridor, between 4th and 5th Streets
cards.notes: Take Hudson Street south to the city-listed Stevens Park and view or use the Little League field only when it is not reserved for organized play.
cards.short_summary: A named municipal field on the Hudson Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Hoboken lists Stevens Park (Little League Field) on Hudson Street between 4th and 5th Streets and identifies a Little League field.
cards.source_title: City of Hoboken Parks, Fields & Facilities
cards.access_notes: City-listed public park; organized field schedules may limit access.

cards.title: Church Square Park
cards.subtitle: Garden Street corridor, between 4th and 5th Streets
cards.notes: Walk the Garden Street corridor to Church Square Park and look for an open basketball court; yield to scheduled programs and posted park rules.
cards.short_summary: A named city park with basketball courts.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Hoboken lists Church Square Park on Garden Street between 4th and 5th Streets and identifies basketball courts.
cards.source_title: City of Hoboken Parks, Fields & Facilities
cards.access_notes: City-listed public park; court availability is not guaranteed.

cards.title: Columbus Park
cards.subtitle: Clinton Street corridor, between 9th and 10th Streets
cards.notes: Use the Clinton Street corridor to reach Columbus Park, where the city documents both basketball and tennis courts; bring appropriate equipment if playing.
cards.short_summary: A named park with basketball and tennis courts.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Hoboken lists Columbus Park on Clinton Street between 9th and 10th Streets and identifies basketball courts and tennis courts.
cards.source_title: City of Hoboken Parks, Fields & Facilities
cards.access_notes: The City identifies Columbus Park as a Hudson County park; court availability is not guaranteed.
